decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith DOK/12/DS 02 Existing Floor Plans and Elevations and DOK/12/DS 02 Proposed Floor Plans and Elevations; received 10 April 2012 and Eaves Detail received 29 May 2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Formation of side covered way and raising of flat roof to existing rear structure with repositioning of doors and windows
